why: One agent, law and fix together, in next/: the full CI run 43723346561 (leg next (3)) found two reds the pull request checks did not run, and the settings tests run one at a time found a third. All three came from this branch. (1) Snapshot.test.ts L14 [secrets] threw `Do not know how to serialize a BigInt`: mail.chunk is the first byte-size setting and decodes to a bigint, and the law printed the resolved values with plain JSON. The law was wrong: the recorded snapshot holds the size as text, the runner keeps the cut size as a number, and no product code prints decoded values as JSON. The law now prints a bigint as its digits through one helper, used for spans and the error too, and still searches every value. (2) instance-records.integration.test.ts P12 recording/content: the new process.ack span tags the reader fab.process before its ledger turn, so the sink filed the child ledger.transaction in the reader job with no fab.process of its own. The product was wrong: process.ack now annotates every span inside it with the reader process. P12 is green on origin/main 27512b5f7 (13 of 13, in a throwaway worktree, since removed), red on this branch before the fix, 13 of 13 after. (3) JsonSchema.test.ts vector expected the JSON default 65536 for mail.chunk, the first text setting, whose editor default is its file spelling 65536 bytes, which the law above it already pins. The vector now expects the file spelling by the declaration format, written without Codec.file.
